name: workbench-setup
description: Foundational connection/config/workflow setup for the whole workbench: generates the root, git-ignored SharePoint connection config from a canonical template; runs the document-workflow intake wizard (source-document identity, requested processing stages, requested output formats -- only implemented renderer profiles offered as executable choices, publication locations, agent-grounding representations, governance/evidence settings) producing a document-workflow profile and a publication profile; validates written configuration/profile files before other plugins consume them. Zero SharePoint tenant I/O (beyond an explicit, opt-in read-only connection test) and zero document extraction/rendering in this version.
